summary: The market is steadying off its lows at midday: the Nifty is holding above 22,650, pharma is leading a partial recovery, and the broader tone is still negative.

detail.leaders: Nifty Pharma and Healthcare; Sun Pharma, Tech Mahindra, SBI, TCS among the Sensex gainers
detail.laggards: FMCG, Auto, Chemicals; Tata group stocks (Tata Motors PV at a 52-week low), Bajaj Finance, HDFC Life
detail.tone: A touch better than 11:30: the latest headline has the Sensex about 500 pts off its low (from 400) and the Nifty above 22,650, after 22,619.90 at 11:00. The bounce is holding but hasn't built momentum.
watch: Whether the Nifty can reclaim 22,700–22,780 (Monday's close) into expiry
Brent and US futures in the European session

top.title: Tata Trusts plan to keep Tata Sons unlisted
top.line: Proposes merging TESS and TCE into Tata Sons so it is no longer a CIC under RBI rules
more: It follows the RBI rejecting Tata Sons' plea to deregister as a CIC
The plan needs an RBI no-objection; Tata Trusts own 66% of Tata Sons
Tata Motors PV, Tata Investment and Tata Chemicals fell on the news
